status: Frozen before target-cache loading, coexpression calculations or permutation outcomes; local timestamp, not external preregistration.
question: Does the fixed17-gene additive mean signature identify coordinated within-cell expression beyond a patient- and coarse-depth-conditioned independence null?
study_type: Exploratory dataset-specific joint-structure diagnostic; permutation principles are established, not a novel method.
prior_information: Prior patient mean scores, cohort metadata, depth range, cache shape and root depth-analysis plan were known. No new coexpression variance, joint-detection or permutation outcomes inspected before this freeze.
cohort: Exactly35 previous primary-eligible LUAD patients:26TN/9MRD;121083 malignant singlet nuclei;MRD2 remains one patient. No new filtering.
score: For each nucleus compute17 float64 values log1p(10000*geneUMI/totalUMI), including zeros; per-cell score is their arithmetic mean. Detection is the corresponding value>0.

bins.construction: Within each patient, sort by totalUMI using independent seeded random tie-breaking, then split sorted positions into10 nearly equal contiguous rank groups with numpy.array_split. Bins are fixed across permutations.
bins.limitations: Depth conditioning is coarse; residual depth variation, ambient RNA, technical quality, biological cell subtypes and gene capture dependence can survive.

permutation.operation: Independently permute each normalized-gene column within every fixed patient-depth bin. Detection travels with that same normalized value. Preserve every per-gene empirical marginal within each bin; remove cross-gene association conditional on the bin.
permutation.invariants: Per-patient mean additive score and mean number of detected genes are mathematically invariant; floating-point tolerance1e-12 for means. Per-gene sums are checked every permutation with tolerance1e-11 relative/1e-10 absolute.
permutation.boundary: Permuted normalized vectors are not synthetic count vectors with valid conserved totalUMI; this is a conditional association diagnostic, not a multinomial molecular mechanism.

primary: Within-patient population variance (ddof0) of the per-cell17-gene mean score
Within-patient fraction of nuclei detecting at least5 of the17 genes
reported: Observed/null variance ratio if denominator positive
All patient aggregates and null replicate metrics; no cell-level exports
metrics.analytic_check: Calculate exact conditional-null expected variance from weighted within-bin sum of per-gene population variances/17^2 plus between-bin variance of bin mean scores. Calculate exact expected breadth>=5 using the Poisson-binomial distribution of17 within-bin detection proportions. Report MonteCarlo deviations rather than changing method based on them.

inference.unit: Patient; all35 weighted equally, never nuclei or permutation replicates as independent patients.
inference.primary_summary: Mean and median patient-level observed-minus-null differences for both metrics, across all35.
inference.uncertainty: 10000 patient bootstrap resamples of patient excesses; percentile95% intervals condition on observed patients/annotations/bins and estimated null means. They do not cover confounding or model misspecification.
inference.secondary_descriptive: Summarize observed/null/excess by TN andMRD and by source-implied v3.1/v4; mixed-kitMRD2 remains pooled. State contrasts are descriptive and cannot establish treatment effects.
inference.p_values: None; no cell-level tests, individual-patient significance declarations or multiplicity-selected gene findings.

interpretation_rules: Greater observed score variance indicates joint dependence beyond the coarse-conditioned independence reference; it does not establish coordinated regulation or a causal persister state.
Positive dependence can increase or decrease a thresholded breadth fraction, depending on marginals. A negative>=5 excess does not mean no coherence.
Covariance cannot shift the expected additive mean when gene marginals are preserved; never claim it explains mean-score reversal.
A small or null discrepancy does not exclude real programs under sparse measurement.
Preserve both endpoints, nulls and all patient directions; do not select a favorable patient or assay.
validation: Verify cache SHA against sidecar and frozen protocol, genes/order/IDs against prior sources, shape, integer/nonnegative counts and counts<=depth.
Reproduce previous patient score means to1e-12.
Synthetic all-zero and perfectly coexpressed5-gene fixtures: exact means and detection breadth invariance; independently known analytic null variance and>=5 probability.
Validate all empirical per-gene marginals by construction and sum checks, plus additive-score/mean-breadth invariance every replicate.
